title: Producer grants accept exactly one token per producer: rotation has a guaranteed failure window
wanted_capability: Overlap-tolerant producer-grant rotation: a producer grant should accept an ordered list of tokens per producer_id (constant-time verification, matched-token observability) so a token rotation can stage the new token on both sides before retiring the old one. Today a grant names exactly one token_file per producer, so every rotation is a simultaneous two-sided cutover with a guaranteed window where the producer's publishes are refused. Proposed as phase 6 of design/operations/config-artifacts/secrets-provider.md.
missing_primitive: Multi-token producer grant (ordered accepted-token list) with per-token match observability
fallback_used: Rotate during a quiet window and accept the refusal gap; or tolerate a brief red publish cycle since a full rescan is always safe.
notes: Surfaced 2026-08-11 while modernizing the secrets-provider design for the connector campaign.
resolution_note: Overlap-tolerant rotation shipped on beta/blackbox-v2 ea551ae8 (fold of feat/producer-grant-rotation, cluster-verified): ServiceTokenSet in bro-rpc (ordered slots, no short-circuit, matched index only, slot-count Debug); token_files list on both code_collection and source_connectors producer grants with loud both/neither/empty refusals and singular back-compat; matched-slot observability in logs and runtime status; secrets-provider phase 6 and operator rotation runbook written.
